features.label: Believable forms
features.explanation: Simplify the source image’s subjects through accurate overall proportions and connected volumes of light and shadow
features.evidence: The volumes of the figure and sofa can be read through a few connected broad planes of light and dark.
features.zh: 以准确的大比例和相连的明暗体块概括原图主体
features.en: Simplify the source image’s subjects through accurate overall proportions and connected volumes of light and shadow

features.label: Hard and soft edges
features.explanation: Keep key contours clear and let secondary edges merge softly into the surroundings
features.evidence: The face and hands are more concisely rendered, while some edges of the dress and sofa merge into the surrounding colors.
features.zh: 让关键轮廓清楚，次要边缘柔和地融入环境
features.en: Keep key contours clear and let secondary edges merge softly into the surroundings

features.label: Silver gray and warm colors
features.explanation: Use relationships between silver gray, soft white and muted warm browns, retaining a little cool reflected color
features.evidence: Cool blue and pale green reflections appear in the silver-gray and soft-white fabric, with warm browns in the background.
features.zh: 采用银灰、柔白和低饱和暖褐的色彩关系，保留少量冷色反光
features.en: Use relationships between silver gray, soft white and muted warm browns, retaining a little cool reflected color

features.label: Broad light and shadow planes
features.explanation: Model volume through broad, continuous lit planes, reducing scattered highlights
features.evidence: Large light areas on the dress support smaller reflected highlights, while the dark areas retain tonal variation.
features.zh: 用宽阔而连贯的受光面塑造体积，减少零碎高光
features.en: Model volume through broad, continuous lit planes, reducing scattered highlights

features.label: Clear visual hierarchy
features.explanation: Within the original composition, concentrate detail on the subjects and reduce sharpness in secondary areas
features.evidence: The reclining figure occupies the main horizontal space, while background details are relatively subdued.
features.zh: 在原构图中集中描绘主体，降低次要区域的清晰度
features.en: Within the original composition, concentrate detail on the subjects and reduce sharpness in secondary areas

features.label: Economical brushwork
features.explanation: Retain visible brushstrokes that follow changes in form, suggesting details through patches of color
features.evidence: Short diagonal strokes on the skirt reveal both folds and reflected light.
features.zh: 保留顺着形体转折的可见笔触，细节由色块暗示
features.en: Retain visible brushstrokes that follow changes in form, suggesting details through patches of color

features.label: Everyday quiet
features.explanation: Create a natural, unhurried and quiet viewing experience
features.evidence: The relaxed pose, soft edges and low-contrast setting together establish a quiet rhythm.
features.zh: 营造自然、从容、安静的观看感受
features.en: Create a natural, unhurried and quiet viewing experience

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
